with open('notes.txt', 'w', encoding='UTF8') as f:
    f.write('räksmörgås\n')

with open('notes.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:

with open(file='data.txt', mode='rt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for line in f:
        print(line.strip())

    f.write('appended\n')

    open('notes.txt', bogus=1)
except TypeError as e:
    print('TypeError')

try:
    open('missing.txt', encoding='utf-8')
except FileNotFoundError:
    print('missing')
